outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows fluorescence, H&E and bright-field images (micrographs), not a quantitative plot showing averages.
Panel C is a bar chart of mean lactate concentration with 95% CI, and individual data points (dots for each region) are overlaid on the bars for all three groups.
Panel D is a bar chart of mean lactate concentration with 95% CI, and individual data points (dots for each region) are overlaid on both bars (high pH and low pH).
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment model, not a data plot.
